records.name: Thorn
records.held_by: Vicecanons and the saltrice field-owners
records.summary: Thorn is the north-east's one large city, a grassland border town on the Padomaic coast beside the road to Tear in Morrowind. It lives on saltrice, tolls and smuggling, and is run by Vicecanons and the families who hold the old saltrice fields. Its guards are paid to look the other way.

terrain_needs.why: the harbour on the bay to its east

notes.text: Thorn is one of the eight major cities of Black Marsh, in the grassland of Thornmarsh in the north-east, with Morrowind and the road to Tear to its north. Its epithet is the Jewel of the East: as deadly as it is beautiful, a city where vagabonds eye purses and the guards turn a blind eye.

notes.text: The Barsaebic Ayleids founded it. House Dres raided it in the mid-First Era and rose to a Great House on the slaves taken; Dres ruled it in the Second Era until Heita-Meen, once a slave in its saltrice fields, killed Councilor Glathis Dres in 2E 572. In the Third Era it was a city-state under King Tibus and rival to Archon, and the Arnesian War of 3E 396 was fought on its border.

notes.text: In 4E 201 Thorn is intact and the most prosperous place in the north-east. With Dres gone the saltrice fields passed to whoever stood in them: freed labourers' descendants and the ex-Archein families who managed them. Who holds title to which field is the city's standing quarrel, settled by Vicecanons when it is settled at all.

records.summary: Noota Nara is a village below Fort Chalkmoth where, in legend, the villagers once heated spear-tips in a dragon's own fire and killed it. Its walls are rebuilt and its grievance, the dragon's lost head, is not forgotten.
